packageRules.description: Group Nix flake input updates into a single PR
Group non-major CI action updates in .forgejo/workflows; major bumps get their own PR
Group non-major devDependency updates; the toolchain here moves together, and the pairs that have to agree (vitest with @vitest/coverage-v8, tailwindcss with @tailwindcss/vite) do so in one PR
Hold TypeScript below v7: typescript-eslint v8 peers on typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, so v7 (the native tsgo rewrite) breaks type-aware lint. Revisit when typescript-eslint supports it
